title: TransUNet: Transformers Make Strong Encoders for Medical Image Segmentation
mechanism: ResNet-50 stem plus ViT encoder on the 1/16 feature map, cascaded upsampler with CNN skip connections.
adaptation: Benchmark suite: 512 px gray replicated to 3 channels, ImageNet R50-ViT-B/16 init, PF schedule, label-safe aug, same folds and metrics.
min_experiment: TransUNet (PF) 5 folds v house PF; benchmark row. For score: kill if E1 relF1@2 < +0.03 and CV crack relF1@2 < +0.01.
evidence: R: Synapse multi-organ and ACDC gains over U-Net and attention U-Net at release; most cited 2D Transformer U-Net. Counter: Revisited shows Transformers below nnU-Net in 3D.
